name: flightdeck
description: Coordinate portable multi-repository engineering, operations, research, artifacts, compliance, and opt-in durable Missions.

interface.longDescription: Generates a local control plane, discovers and connects existing repositories in place with safe local bridges, routes exact owning tasks, and optionally coordinates durable Missions with bounded observation and controlled fan-in. It preserves approval boundaries, validates workspace health, upgrades safely with patch notes, and provides reusable engineering, CI/CD, platform, database, automation, artifact, compliance, and STIG workflows.
defaultPrompt: Set up Flightdeck for the Git repositories under this folder.
Run this cross-project outcome as a supervised Flightdeck Mission through review-ready, preserving every approval boundary.
Upgrade my Flightdeck plugin without changing my existing Hub or repositories, and show me what changed.
